# Beginner implementation library

**Published learning draft — organizational adoption pending.** Start with
[Start an IMS from scratch](ORR-SOP-IMP-002_START-AN-IMS-FROM-SCRATCH.md), then read
[the fictional chemical-company journey](ORR-REC-IMP-001_FICTIONAL-CHEMICAL-COMPANY-JOURNEY.md).
Use the catalogue to plan the whole scope and the five kits to learn the first loop.

Context → risk/control decision → objective and plan → controlled release →
leadership review → outcome verification or reopening.

For a continuing list of concerns, controls, actions and outcome checks, use the
existing [action-register schema](../ORR-REG-GEN-001_ACTION-REGISTER.md) alongside
the new worksheets. Keep its linked case records in your private operational index;
the public process catalogue tracks template coverage, not your operating risks.

The five kits cover parts of P01, P04, P08 and P20. Remaining processes, including
technical maintenance, environmental/OH&S and full business-continuity workflows,
remain explicit gaps. This is not a complete four-standard system or ISO checklist.

Markdown controls the published template revision. Word copies contain the same
text; Excel forms contain instructions and a blank record sheet, with manual
validation rules. These are editable documents, not an IMS application. Links in
Word are readable companion filenames; keep the folder together. Adapt in private,
assign your organization's configuration, reconcile changes, review and authorize
before use. Never put real operating/employee/customer records in this repository.

Fictional outcomes are not user trials or actual evidence. Office files have been
checked structurally and for content consistency; layout in your Office application
still needs review. No vendor pack, protected source text, macros or external data
connections are included. [Licence and exclusions](../../../LICENSING.md) apply.
